meta.prompt: Where is my package? Today is Sat 15 Nov. Show a tracking card: the item (Nikon Z fc camera body), carrier DHL Express, tracking number JD014600003SE, estimated delivery Tue 18 Nov and how many days away that is, and the shipment's five stages as a timeline with the current one marked: Label created (Nov 12), Picked up (Nov 13), In transit (Nov 14, current), Out for delivery, Delivered. Say which stage it is at ("Stage 3 of 5"). And a field where I can type delivery instructions and a Save button; once saved the card shows them back to me as saved.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Where is my package?" "Nikon Z fc camera body" icon:"local_shipping" status:"In transit"
  Row gap:8
    Text.bodySecondary "Carrier"
    Spacer grow
    Text.strong "DHL Express"
  Row gap:8
    Text.bodySecondary "Tracking"
    Spacer grow
    Text.mono "JD014600003SE"
  Row gap:8
    Text.bodySecondary "Estimated delivery"
    Spacer grow
    Text.strong "Tue 18 Nov (3 days away)"
  SectionLabel "Shipment progress" "Stage 3 of 5"
  Column gap:0
    Row gap:12
      Icon "check_circle"
      Text "Label created · Nov 12"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "check_circle"
      Text "Picked up · Nov 13"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_checked"
      Text.strong "In transit · Nov 14 (current)"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_unchecked"
      Text.muted "Out for delivery"
    Row gap:12
      Icon "radio_button_unchecked"
      Text.muted "Delivered"
  state instructions=""
  state saved=false
  SectionLabel "Delivery instructions"
  if !saved
    InputField "Instructions" "e.g. leave at the side door" =instructions lines:3
    ActionButton "Save" primary icon:"save" enabled:{trim(instructions) != ""} -> saved=true
  if saved
    Callout "Instructions saved" "{instructions}" good "check_circle"
